repository.name: @webex/plugin-people
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.people that reads Webex person records from the Webex REST API (catalog service hydra). get(person) takes a uuid, a hydra person id, a person object, or the string me; me is fetched from people/me with concurrent calls sharing one request, and every other id goes through a batcher that turns concurrent lookups into one GET people/?id=...&showAllTypes=... of up to 10 ids per flush (100 ms quiet, 1500 ms at most). Ids are normalized locally: a uuid becomes the base64url hydra id ciscospark://us/PEOPLE/uuid without a request, so a uuid and its hydra id share one lookup. list(options) resolves an array of persons for an array of ids through the same batcher, or a Page of results for a query object such as email or displayName. Nothing is cached or persisted.

people-public-sdk.summary: Published npm package (public plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers People as public plugin 'people' with the people config from src/config.js; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default People class. webex.people exposes get(person), list(options), inferPersonIdFromUuid(id) (marked @private in its JSDoc), the batcher child, and the underscore-prefixed _getMe; specified in src/docs/README.md.

hydra-people-http.source: Webex REST API people resource (catalog service name hydra, reached through service: 'hydra' in src/people.js and src/people-batcher.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-people-http.summary: GET /people/?id=<comma-joined ids>&showAllTypes=<boolean> answering {items: [person], notFoundIds?: [id]}; GET /people with the caller's query object answering a paged {items} with Link headers; GET /people/me answering the current person. Person ids are base64url of ciscospark://us/PEOPLE/<uuid>.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-008, MOD-013, MOD-044)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin keys a public plugin by its raw name (people, first registration wins) and merges its config into the defaults; WebexPlugin supplies webex, children, namespaced config (config.people for namespace People), logger, and request.

webex-core-batcher.source: @webex/webex-core Batcher (module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-050 to MOD-053; code consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/batcher.js)
webex-core-batcher.summary: Batcher.request de-duplicates by request fingerprint, queues the item as passed, flushes through a capped debounce read from the subclass namespace config (batcherWait, batcherMaxWait, batcherMaxCalls), maps responses back through getDeferredForResponse, and on an HTTP error without a request body rejects every queued deferred with the error.

webex-core-page.summary: new Page(res, webex) stores the body items and parsed Link headers; next and previous request the linked URL and resolve a new Page; iteration yields items in order.

common-base64.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md MOD-006; code consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/base64.js)
common-base64.summary: base64.encode and base64.decode are base64url over urlsafe-base64; hydra ids for PEOPLE always use cluster us (common MOD-006, which constructHydraId implements and this package re-implements inline).

common-one-flight.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md MOD-002)
common-one-flight.summary: Bare @oneFlight keys a flight per instance by method name, returns the in-flight promise to concurrent callers, and drops the flight when it settles, so nothing is cached.
